A VPN, or Virtual Private Network, encrypts your internet traffic and routes it through a remote server so that your activity is hidden from your internet service provider and any local network observers. It makes you appear as if you're browsing from the location of the VPN server rather than your actual one, which helps protect your privacy on public Wi-Fi and can bypass certain regional restrictions.

Climate is the average of those conditions over a long period, like 30 years, for a specific region. Think of it this way: weather is the daily mood of the atmosphere, while climate is its personality.
